relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: Exposure of DRG neurons to 25 nM PTX for 24 h resulted in a 1.43-fold increase in endogenous Nav1.7 mRNA as determined by real-time PCR

relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: the ProTx-II-sensitive Nav1.7 current density from PTX-treated DRG neurons was significantly larger than that from DMSO-treated neurons

relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed that cultures incubated with 25 nM PTX had more anterogradely moving vesicles per axon (flux) than control axons at all time points

relationships.subject: inflammatory mediators
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared to axons not treated with IM, all conditions showed an increase in vesicular flux when treated with IM

key_findings: Low-dose paclitaxel (25 nM) increased Nav1.7 surface levels and anterograde vesicular flux and velocity in DRG axons, while 250 nM decreased flux; endogenous Nav1.7 mRNA and current density rose.
Inflammatory mediators further increased Nav1.7 surface levels and vesicular trafficking with paclitaxel.
